status: WRITTEN global no-threshold lower bounds for the two contraction denominators, UNREVIEWED and conditional on the 2+2 sector proof
offblock_bound: For y=(E,F), singular values a1≥a2,b1≥b2 of the 2×2 offblocks, and any isometry Ψ, ⟨y,Ny⟩=2(||E||²+||F||²)−||XnΨ||² ≥2(a2²+b2²). This follows from the exact universal offblock spectrum; the bound is tight when Ψ spans the top two right singular vectors.
diagonal_bound: For x=(Ad,Bd) write Ad=(αI+C1)⊕(−αI+C2), Bd=(βI+D1)⊕(−βI+D2). Let g be the minimum of: each same-sector gap 4|εrα−εsβ|²+2||C_(3−r)||²+2||D_(3−s)||²; each same-row gap 2||C_(3−r)||²; each same-column gap 2||D_(3−s)||²; and each opposite-sector gap 2Σ_i(||Ai||F²−||Ai||op²)+2Σ_j(||Bj||F²−||Bj||op²)+(ar−bs)²+(ar′−bs′)² for r≠r′,s≠s′. The exhaustive 2+2 proof gives ⟨x,Dx⟩≥2L_d−S2(Xd)≥g≥0 for every Ψ. This bound may vanish away from actual saturation and is not a complete equality classification.
unpaid: The cross term remains to be bounded by the product of actual D and N gaps; substituting these sufficient lower bounds is not automatically enough. No contraction proof, new local-threshold class, physical q/counterexample, numeric sample, execution or η conclusion.
